observations.body: Paul names kinship, adoption, glory, covenants, law, service, promises, ancestors, and Christ, then says not all from Israel are Israel and develops the argument through Isaac, Jacob, Esau, mercy, and hardening.

payload.posture: Read Romans 9:1–18 as israel in apostolic argument and final vision evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The same name Israel identifies both a broad kinship group and a further distinction whose scope unfolds across Romans 9–11.
